title: Unauthorized signature cancellation in `ExecutionModule`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In the `ExecutionModule.sol` contract, the `cancelSignature` function allows an authorized user to cancel a signature by marking a nonce as used. This functionality is intended to invalidate any signed messages associated with that nonce, preventing further execution.
